newsitem.title: USA: Service Merchandise sees charge for closings.
newsitem.headline: Service Merchandise sees charge for closings.

text.p: Service Merchandise Co Inc said Thursday it would close 60 stores and its Las Vegas distribution center and take a pre-tax charge of $130 million in the first quarter in connection with the closings.
The total financial impact of the closings and other strategic inititatives would not exceed $175 million, the company said.
The company said it anticipates a reduction in ordinary operating results over the next several quarters and possibly into next year.
Service Merchandise said it would free up $75 million in capital as a result of the real estate and inventory disposition from the sale.
The company anticipates approximately 1,100 full-time and 2,200 part-time jobs will be eliminated due to the store closures and the closure of the Nevada distribution center.
Severance costs included in the anticipated charges related to the closures are estimated to be $3 million.
